select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID id, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID text from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl where tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F37} and tfpdl.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} and tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
and tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like '%'|| #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'
union all select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID id, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID text from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID where tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F37} and tfpdl.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} and tfpdl.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and tfpdl.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
and tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like '%'|| #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'

select FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, NVL(FINPROD_ABBR, FINPROD_NAME) text from FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37'
and (instr(FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(FINPROD_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(FINPROD_NAME, #{search}) > 0 or instr(FINPROD_ABBR, #{search}) > 0)

select f.FINPROD_ID finprodId, f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, f.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, f.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, f.VDATE vdate, f.MDATE mdate, fa.REF_ENTITY refEntity, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, f.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, fa.REF_SEC refSec, fa.SETTLE_METHOD settleMethod from FIN_PRODUCT f left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fa on fa.FINPROD_ID = f.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fa.REF_ENTITY where f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} and f.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37'

select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.M_DELIVERY_TYPE settleMethod, TDTA.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fpd.REF_ENTITY where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.M_DELIVERY_TYPE settleMethod, TDTA.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fpd.REF_ENTITY where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) repNomCapi, nvl(T.SHARE_AMT, 0) deliverBondAmount, DECODE(TG.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, '02', nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0), NVL(T.TRADE_AMT, 0)) deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tfpdl left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TG ON TG.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01') T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TFPDL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' union all select TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) repNomCapi, nvl(T.SHARE_AMT, 0) deliverBondAmount, DECODE(TG.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, '02', nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0), NVL(T.TRADE_AMT, 0)) deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tfpdl left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TG ON TG.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01') T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TFPDL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37'

select p.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 repNomCapi, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 deliverBondAmount, p.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId from PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE p left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = p.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = p.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on p.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} and p.CDATE = #{tradeDate} and p.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' and p.DATE_TYPE = 0

select p.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 repNomCapi, nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 deliverBondAmount, p.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId from PTL_SEC_POSITION p left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = p.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = p.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on p.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} and p.CDATE = #{tradeDate} and p.HODING_TYPE = '03'

select nvl(p.AMOUNT, 0) from PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE p left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = p.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = p.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on p.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where p.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} and p.CDATE = #{tradeDate} and p.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' and p.DATE_TYPE = 0
